name: Russia–Ukraine
value: US envoys in Moscow 12 Nov; 123 drones overnight
summary: US envoys reached Moscow 12 Nov after Abu Dhabi talks gave a POW deal but no ceasefire; a drone killed 1 in Kyiv
state: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Moscow on 12 Nov to meet President Putin, after Abu Dhabi talks ended on 11 Nov with a large prisoner-exchange deal but no ceasefire (ABC News; Bloomberg). Ukraine's air force said Russia launched 123 drones plus ballistic and cruise missiles overnight on 11–12 Nov; one person was killed and seven injured in Kyiv. The IAEA said a Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant worker was killed in a drone attack on 9 Nov (The Moscow Times). That nuclear-safety incident keeps the Alert.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to Ukraine. Europe's energy and grain markets remain exposed to strikes on Ukrainian and Russian infrastructure and ports.
rubric_hit: Nuclear-plant safety incident (Alert): Zaporizhzhia worker killed by drone 9 Nov, per IAEA; no ceasefire
